## MapGroupInstance

MapGroupInstance places one prototype at a concrete map location in a map group
file.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 4 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### MapGroupInstance.a

Key: `a`

Path: [`group`](#mapgroupposfilegroup).`[]`.`a`

| Type | `string` |
